deck: TEST NARROW PROBLEMS, BUYER DEMAND, AND DELIVERY ECONOMICS
BUILD SPECIALIZED AI TOOLS AROUND REAL CUSTOMER WORKFLOWS
site_ui.lead: Explore how practitioners turn recurring manual work and dissatisfaction with existing tools into focused AI products, testing customer demand, distribution, workflow reliability, and margins along the way.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies with timestamped inline attribution. They examine problem selection, vertical specialization, building and launching, application security, AI costs, billing, recurring-revenue economics, platform integrations, discovery, and retention without flattening competing approaches into a single formula.

flow: Map repeated manual work, study complaints about existing tools, and validate that the problem exists beyond your own workplace.
Identify where customers will come from and explore customer segments one at a time before committing to development.
Sell a single valuable outcome, seek outside customer usage, and make any pre-sale delivery and refund commitments explicit.
Separate judgment from mechanical tasks and build specialized AI workflows around customer needs, relevant data, and integrations.
Resolve missing authentication before publishing paid-generation features, define gold-standard answers, and rerun existing tests after prompt changes.
Compare pricing with delivery costs, reassess free-plan limits, and track whether product improvements strengthen gross margins.
